_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest). 1: one well-known property (prime, divides by 11, reads the same backwards); 2: one step on the digits (they add up to the same total) or one step between a pair (× 7, × 3 + 1); 3: two steps (twice the square, n² − n, n³ + n), or a rule between digits (1st − 2nd = 3rd); 4: three steps, letters and numbers together, or a rule only the other three share and that must be found from them. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
